overview: Docket on Japanese tonnage measurement: Japan's 1932 law and 1936 amendments, mutual recognition of certificates, and US technical comments on shelter-deck measurement rules.

subfiles.title: List of papers on the admeasurement of Japanese merchant vessels
subfiles.about: An index summarizes 1933 and 1937 correspondence about Japanese ship-measurement legislation and reciprocal recognition of vessel-tonnage certificates.
subfiles.summary: Docket (1933-37) covers Japan's ship-measurement law and 1936 amendments, leading the US to continue reciprocal recognition of tonnage certificates after exchanging technical comments.

interest: Shows 1930s Japan-US technical reciprocity on merchant-vessel tonnage measurement standards.
